info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Syndicate Management API
info.description: The Syndicate Management API provides capabilities for updating the details of existing syndicates within the banking ecosystem. This endpoint allows financial institutions to modify syndicate configurations and associated parameters as necessary. Typical consumers of this API include bank administrators and finance managers who need to ensure that syndicate operations align with regulatory requirements and business objectives. By enabling precise updates, this API supports efficient management and governance of external agency collaborations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific syndicate management resource identified by its unique ID. Ensure that the payload contains the necessary fields that you wish to modify, and use appropriate error handling to manage any potential issues during the update process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the syndicate information for the specified external agency. It allows you to modify the existing details related to the syndicate based on the given request parameters.

200.description: Request processed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
